create_model_card_from_trainer: create a model card from a Trainer instance using TrainingSummary.from_trainer with eval results and hyperparameters
generate_model_card_text: generate a full Markdown model card string from a TrainingSummary instance using to_model_card
parse_trainer_log_history: parse Trainer log history to extract intermediate evaluation results and final metrics
extract_training_hyperparameters: extract training hyperparameters from a Trainer instance including batch size, optimizer, and scheduler settings
infer_metric_tags_from_results: infer metric tags from evaluation results dictionary by matching against known metric tag names
